tidbit: Did you know… about 16,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI introduced GPT 6.1 Terra, a new model that improves on GPT-5.6 Terra with faster tasks, lower cost, and better accuracy, confirmed by Digit.
Publishers are suing Anthropic for $48.6M, reported by Türkiye Today, over the use of Elvis Presley songs in artificial intelligence training.
KT unveiled Token Factory with 73 artificial intelligence models and unified billing, cutting costs by up to 25%, confirmed by 디지털투데이.
Student Adhiraj Chauhan builds artificial intelligence apps for mental health and water quality, winning awards and securing government funding, confirmed by LatestLY.
SWI Group launched SWI Compute with a $1B NVIDIA order and a UK artificial intelligence factory starting in 2027, reported by ET Datacenters.
Free every hour.
